summary: Follow a file from your device to the cloud, then see how uploads resume, versions stay recoverable and devices catch up.
scope: An original educational walkthrough of a Drive-like design. The public Drive API documents upload, revisions, sharing and changes. The internal service topology and technologies shown here are illustrative.
author: Thoth

sources.title: Google Drive API · Sharing and permissions

componentNotes.desktop: A desktop sync client watches a local folder and sends edits to the file service.
componentNotes.web: The browser requests a file or preview.
componentNotes.mobile: The phone sends reads and uploads, and resumes a transfer when the network returns.
componentNotes.lb: The load balancer sends requests to healthy API instances.
componentNotes.api: The REST gateway routes requests to the appropriate service and applies rate limits.
componentNotes.auth: The authentication service checks who is asking. File permissions determine what that person may do.
componentNotes.users: The users database stores account records and identity references.
componentNotes.upload: The resumable upload session remembers which bytes arrived. The upload service checks available storage before accepting the save.
componentNotes.chunks: Chunking and deduplication split a file into pieces. Matching pieces can be reused within one security boundary.
componentNotes.storage: Object storage holds the encrypted pieces and replicates them for durability.
componentNotes.metadata: The metadata database stores the name, owner, current version and references to stored pieces.
componentNotes.versions: The version service stores prior versions. A restore makes a prior version current again.
componentNotes.permissions: The access control list determines who can view, comment or edit the file.
componentNotes.jobs: The background dispatcher schedules follow-up work after the save.
componentNotes.search: The search index stores allowed file names and supported text so users can find files later.
componentNotes.previews: The preview service makes thumbnails after the file is saved.
componentNotes.scan: The scanning service looks for malware and data loss prevention policy violations. Access can be restricted while scanning is pending.
componentNotes.quota: The usage worker records storage consumption after a save. The upload service enforces the storage quota before committing the file.
componentNotes.trash: The retention worker keeps files temporarily recoverable and removes unreferenced pieces after expiry.
componentNotes.sync: The sync service keeps a change log. Clients can request the changes they missed after going offline.
componentNotes.queue: The event queue buffers save and sharing changes for downstream workers. Kafka is an example implementation.
componentNotes.notify: A push gateway sends a signal, for example over WebSocket. The receiving client then fetches authorized changes.
componentNotes.other-desktop: The notebook sync client checks for updates after receiving a signal.
componentNotes.other-web: The browser refreshes its view after pulling changes.
componentNotes.other-mobile: The phone catches up from its last checkpoint when it reconnects.
